consumer: law_set dataset governance chain (gate + bundle export + distribution consumers)
title: Evorule verification constant entry (law_set dataset payload)
description: Verification constant entry payload contract for law_set datasets. Carries a physical/verification constant as value + SI unit plus provenance metadata (source required; uncertainty and verified optional). Dataset version snapshots and push-event mechanisms are reused as-is; this contract defines the entry-level metadata shape only.
